notes.title: Winter Update
notes.notes:
Dear Knights of the Rose,
Hope this finds you well and you had plenty of mushroom soup these days.
This update focuses on another set of quality improvements. 
Due to a popular request we’ve decided to slightly increase Liliy’s movement speed, making it quicker to roam the Kingdom of Blossom. 
Besides various bug fixes we’ve also reworked the Spanish translation to provide a flawless experience for our Spanish speaking players. Have fun!

Patchotes:

   Slightly increased movement speed
   Reworked Spanish translation
   Bug fixes

notes.title: First feature update!
notes.notes:
Hello fellow gamers!
 
With this update we tackle minor bugs and some of the common requests from the community by introducing some new convenience features!
 
Customizable controls for keyboard and gamepad
One of the main requests was to implement a system to customize the control scheme to your liking. Here you go! After updating the game you’ll find the customization menu in the game settings under “Controls”.
 
Reduce camera motion
As some of you had issues with the current camera behavior we are introducing an “Reduce camera motion” option. You’ll find it in the settings menu under “Graphics”. 

As for other requests we can assure you that this isn’t the last update and we are listening to your feedback and constantly working on improving Blossom Tales to guarantee you a good time with the game.

We are eager to hear your feedback and hope that you'll have fun with Blossom Tales!

notes.title: Release date announced & Pax East
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We are proud and happy to finally have a release date for Blossom Tales: The Sleeping King! On March 28th you'll be able to dive right into the Kingdom of Blossom and start an epic journey.

If you can't wait anymore to try the game we'd love to welcome you at the FDG Entertainment booth at Pax East in Boston! Come around and check out Blossom Tales! 

Stay up to date by following us on Twitter:
#BlossomTales
@FDG_Games
@castlepixel
